releases.displayName: The latest Hozy Update is here ✨Thank you for 500K renovators!

items.text: Hello, renovators!

Firstly, we have to say a big thank you to each and every one of you; we’ve just hit 500k renovators! We greatly appreciate everyone who’s taken the time to download and play Hozy, and we hope you’ve been enjoying our labour of love so far.
Today, we’re also really pleased to share the latest Hozy update with you, with new gamepad controls and a couple of new additions to celebrate our console release!

notes.title: Spooky season is coming to an end

items.text: If you haven’t had a chance to try the latest Halloween level, you still have time - we’ll be removing the seasonal room on November 13 - don’t worry, it will be back next year, and you’ll still be able to use the seasonal items in Sandbox Mode, so you can incorporate some spooky vibes into your builds all year round!
Need some inspiration? Check out some of our favourite screenshots from our wonderful Hozy community so far below!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/6b489bac50677f2d0bfeaf6f4abbe1d0164fd25c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/c85bd3cb82eafc17f198dff1a5f028485eb91651.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/bb2af1d338c4f8a841b8c926c398abbf83680ca4.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/5dbaf69313ea88841e6aaa55459f9debf4b4cbfc.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/5ccf0d65672d99eca7d948176dd61a355b73d4b2.png"]
We’ll see you soon in our next seasonal event, so keep your eyes peeled for the announcement!

Whilst developing our brand new console editions of Hozy, we’ve had the opportunity to completely revamp our gamepad controls for all players, meaning you can now enjoy a more streamlined, tactile experience as you clean, paint, and decorate your way through the levels and Sandbox Mode.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/65563830ac482e5bd9b2a15fdc00b1c25e9d660b.gif"]

notes.title: Create the Perfect Cozy Gaming Set Up ✨

items.text: To celebrate Hozy’s launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox X/S today, we’ve added iconic versions of these consoles in-game for you to create the perfect gaming set-up! You can add them to the Attic and Penthouse levels in-game (you’ll need to restart these levels to place them). You can also play a little mini-game on them!
We can’t wait to see how you use these two iconic consoles in your builds, so make sure to share on socials with #MakeItHozy!
If you haven’t had a chance to share a review for Hozy on Steam yet, please do consider it! Even a few short sentences can help to shape the future of Hozy.

releases.displayName: The Hozy Halloween Update is here! 🎃

items.text: Trick or treat, renovators!
It’s this time of the year…Hozy’s free Halloween update is now available!
Get your spook on 👻
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/1cc2bb5859ffb747ad05a36d9b894a0f4b10cb39.gif"]

Decorate an all-new version of the Treehouse with jack-o'-lanterns, creepy costumes, and some extra spooky trinkets to get yourself in the mood for the most ghoulish time of the year in this totally reimagined space!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/727c0b0cf1e3a670c9d517bcc0541cd805d554bb.gif"]
No tricks, only treats - you’ll also be able to incorporate these fiendish new decorations into your Sandbox Mode levels, too!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/eabcd082fb387a003d1c71c8608c8a5f49c55e28.gif"]
If you haven’t had a chance to share a review for Hozy on Steam yet, please do consider it! Even a few short sentences can help to shape the future of Hozy.
Hello, renovators!
A small update 1.35 is now available for PC and Mac.
This update includes dozens of small fixes related to painting and cleaning mechanics, with a particular focus on macOS.
We’ve also fixed an issue affecting the Dark Music Hall level on Medium graphics settings, where a huge shadow from an invisible object covered half of a wall.

releases.displayName: Hozy: Hideaways is now available on Mac ✨ Plus a Small Update!

items.text: Hello, renovators!
We’re pleased to share that the Hozy: Hideaways DLC is now available on Mac!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/6f5cc21e81a25646c6768ac4c983b7489596d643.gif"]

Mac players will now have access to all three new levels available in the free DLC: the Chic Condo, Greenhouse, and Tech Studio. Enjoy new mechanics like trimming grass, cleaning off cobblestones, and removing the tired old rugs as you discover these three new residencies - a renovator’s job is tough, but we know you can do it!
We also have an update for all players with some general fixes and improvements; plus, there’s a brand new playable video game in the Tech Studio for you to play - let us know your high score 👀
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/cfacd20d5eeee5a0827d614ecd66a11102951ae3.gif"]
We’ve also got some small bug fixes and improvements for you, too. Check out the full list below, or just update the game to experience the changes!
New
Hozy: Hideaways Free DLC is now available on Mac.
Added a playable video game to the Tech Studio location.
Improvements
Improved the paint roller mechanics for a smoother experience.
Improved the mop mechanics and interactions for a smoother experience.
Various localization fixes and improvements across supported languages.
Fixes
Fixed an issue in the Treehouse where a task could sometimes be counted incorrectly.
Fixed an issue where save data could be affected when closing the game with Alt+F4.
Hello, renovators!
As we continue working on the exciting new updates, we also want to set aside time to fix some of the immediate bugs reported to us.
This small patch addresses a few of these pesky bugs! Thank you so much for the reports. If you encounter any other issues, please feel free to report them to us via the official Hozy Discord server.

notes.title: Here is what has been fixed

items.text: Fixed rugs falling through other objects after loading a save.

Rugs use special placement rules that allow them to remain under furniture and be stored rolled up. After updating their physics for Sandbox Mode, the new logic was not correctly applied to the first level. Rugs should now remain in their proper positions after loading a save.
Fixed the paintbrush on the Dream level not returning to the paint bucket.
This was caused by an incorrect configuration value.
Fixed saving progress for completed levels.
Previously, progress could fail to save if a player completed a level but left it using the Exit button instead of Finish. Completed levels should now save correctly in both cases.
Hello, renovators!
We’re thrilled to be able to share with you the latest update for Hozy, featuring the rest of the Game Plus Levels and our first version of Sandbox Mode!
Yes, you read that right: the first iteration of the long-awaited and highly requested Sandbox Mode has arrived!

We are just getting started, so you’ll be able to expect further updates in future, including the ability to change the actual geometry of the room. We’d love your feedback and any suggestions on what you’d like to see added to the mode, so do share them on Steam Forums or Discord (link at the end of this post)!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/30698b83d942033db54111c0758e20a6aad2c082.gif"]
Select your favourite flooring and wall options at just the click of your cursor, using various styles and colours to create the room of your dreams.
Then, select from any of the in-game furniture and decorative items to create something special. You can even scroll through the boxes and choose exactly which furniture you’d like to place!
As we mentioned in our previous update, all of the rooms in Hozy now have a Game Plus variation, allowing you to experience a fun new side of each of the spaces!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/87e1d253ffa68a4e2142b823b57c5b676b951f87.gif"]

So now, once you’ve finished Hozy’s main story, you’ll be able to reselect any of your previously completed levels and enter the Game Plus version of the room, with totally different furniture (and occupants!) than the original one.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/03e6df3fc2912f50c594af4ff567e5006113133f.gif"]

We’ve been keeping a close eye on feedback, and we noticed that a lot of you would like more of a choice in which pieces of furniture to unpack from each of the boxes, so now you will have a new setting available to allow you to scroll through each of the items in a box and decide which you’d like to take out first!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/0f16236a62acde4fbe8a5f31ad6b1d83dc7d3db2.gif"]
We hope this will make it easier for you to create the cozy room of your dreams, and can’t wait to see what you create!
If you haven’t had a chance to share a review for Hozy on Steam yet, please do consider it! Even a few short sentences can help to shape the future of Hozy.

We are so pleased to share a brand new update with you today, featuring some end game content for those of you who have completed the existing rooms and are looking for something fresh: the 1.1 Update, featuring Game+.

Once you’ve finished renovating the current rooms available as part of Alex’s story, you’ll now be able to unlock alternative versions of some of your previously completed levels, with both lighting options and an alternative set of furniture.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/4aec94d0b743ed00965381836dc9f613e99f8cf5.gif"]
For example, you can now decorate the Attic with items from the Workshop, making it a cozy little art studio - and check out how lovely the fireplace looks at night!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/7fd8b196ef57613c89c8b56b0b37cf1d88638c18.gif"]
These new options will be available for the Attic, Workshop, Tree House, Small Apartment, and Café for the time being, but we’ll be adding in the remaining rooms in a future update!

Of course, we’ve also provided some bug fixes and general improvements in this update, too - check the changelog at the end of this post for all the details, or just update your game now and dive right in!
Don’t forget to share your screenshots with us on Bluesky, Twitter, TikTok, Threads, and Instagram, with #MakeItHozy and keep up with the latest news!
Added alternative versions for the Attic, Workshop, Tree House, Small Apartment, and Bar. To unlock them, you need to finish the game.
After finishing the game for the above-mentioned levels, you will unlock the ability to switch between day and night.
Remixes of existing music tracks were added for the five mentioned levels.
Fixed the mechanics of naming your Bar - input should now properly behave and save.
Fixed a bug where leaves and cards could respawn as trash when loading the level.
Fixed Blackout podium physics, which sometimes blocked the ability to put furniture on it until reloading the level.
Fixed the carpets disappearing after deselecting them with RMB.
Fixed most cases of items disappearing during level launch. This should also at least partially fix rare issues when some boxes are not properly loaded, and you cannot finish the level.
Fixed the issue of wall items getting stuck together.
Tree House - improved mechanics of throwing items away.
Workshop - fixed an issue where returning to the level via Continue could cause music to stop playing.
Fixed Dream level wall painting condition not being triggered correctly.

notes.title: Known issues we are working on

items.text: Mac version only: Achievements should now be correctly triggered.
Mac version only: Screenshots should now save correctly.
Can you believe that more than 200,000 of you have made Alex's little world your own? We are so incredibly grateful for each and every one of you. This community means everything to us!
We've been hard at work on new Hozy content, and a full roadmap is on its way. But today, we just couldn't wait to share a little something with you first!
Once you complete Hozy's current story by finishing work on all available levels, you'll be able to unlock alternative versions of the levels you've already played through.
This will let you look at familiar, well-loved locations in a whole new light — literally!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/3739ea2f8977c355aa742e5ea496699048b514cf.gif"]
Each level will offer several lighting options as well as an alternative set of furniture. For example, you'll be able to transform the artist's workshop into a cozy café!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/89d639a3ceae46c45b49b19ddd328db730038a07.gif"]
The alternative versions will initially be available for the Attic, Workshop, Tree House, Small Apartment, and Bar levels, with all remaining levels coming in one of the following updates.
Just like the classic levels, each alternative set has been carefully curated, and we're genuinely excited for you to experience them!

notes.title: Sandbox Experience and the future updates

items.text: New Game + doesn't mean we're giving up on the fully-fledged Sandbox Experience that the community has been asking for so passionately!

We want to deliver a truly great experience, and for that, we just need a little more time. The Sandbox Experience is in active development, and we'll be releasing it in several iterations, gathering and incorporating your feedback along the way!
Think of New Game + as a fresh way to fall in love with Hozy all over again — while the Sandbox Experience gets the attention it truly deserves.
We have so many plans for Hozy, and thanks to YOU, we will be able to make them happen!
Future free updates will add more levels, improved controller support, and more quality-of-life features. Plus, our macOS players, we hear you, and we're on it!
Thank you for being part of Hozy’s journey! 💛
Hello, renovators!

With the festive season well and truly upon us, we simply couldn’t let the holiday season pass without finding a very Hozy way to celebrate! That’s why we’ve added a brand new decorative holiday-themed update to the playtest!
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/8gGW8RPg/Full-Christmas-Room-3.gif"]

You’ll now find snow-covered rooftops, sparkling lights, a Christmas tree, and even presents waiting for you to place in the first level of the playtest, and we can’t wait to see the screenshots of how you decide to decorate! To share yours, use #Hozy on social media, tag us, or post them in our Discord channel! All the links are at the end of this post.
To experience the new decorations (and snow!), simply update or download the Hozy Playtest in your Steam library.
Please note that this level will be available for 1 month (until 15 January), so make sure you try it out before then if you want to be able to enjoy it!

If you’d like to continue to stay updated on Hozy’s development, make sure to wishlist us here on Steam, follow us on Bluesky, Twitter, TikTok, and Instagram, and join our Discord to share your experiences in the playtest so far!
We look forward to having more to share with you soon!

releases.displayName: An Autumn-Themed Playtest Update with a NEW ROOM 🍂

items.text: Hello, renovators!

There’s a slight chill to the air, the leaves are turning, and the desire to stay warm under a blanket or two is stronger than ever…it must be Autumn! Naturally, we couldn’t let one of the coziest seasons pass by without commemorating it somehow, so…we decided to update the Hozy playtest with a brand new Autumn-inspired level for a limited time!
[img src="https://i.ibb.co/67Z6BS63/Hozy-Workshop-Completed-1-1.gif"]

With a warm colour palette, some Halloween decorations, and a sprinkling of falling leaves for you to round up, the new Workshop level is the perfect way to unwind as the days get shorter, and we look forward to seeing your completed versions. Share yours using #Hozy on social media, tagging us, or in our Discord channel! All the links are at the end of this post.

To experience the new room, simply update or download the Hozy Playtest in your Steam library; the Workshop is the third level, but if you don't want to redo the first two levels, you can press Alt+Shift+3 to skip straight ahead.
Please note that this level will be available for 2 weeks (until 13 November), so make sure you try it out before then if you want to be able to enjoy it!

If you’d like to continue to stay updated on Hozy’s development, make sure to wishlist us here on Steam, follow us on Bluesky, Twitter, TikTok, and Instagram, and join our Discord to share your experiences in the playtest so far!
We look forward to having more to share with you soon!

releases.displayName: Playtest Update with Bug Fixes (and Localizations) ✨

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291936/83d44ebda784a28633ded970e9869df23ad04c21.png"]
Hello, renovators!
We're pleased to share that we've just updated the Hozy playtest with a few bug fixes and new localizations!
Fixed an issue where the trash tooltip was getting stuck on Level 1
Fixed an issue with items not disappearing once placed in the Lost & Found Box
Fixed the 'discard' tooltip not disappearing if the feature is not used
Fixed the 'right-click to interact' tooltip not disappearing if the window is not opened
We noticed that some of you were having trouble accessing your screenshots using the dedicated screenshot tool in-game.
To help with this, you'll now find your screenshots saved in a new file location: C:/Users//AppData/Local/CozyGame/Saved
We know Hozy has renovators all around the world trying to revitalize and reinvigorate each room, so we've made it easier for everyone to enjoy the game with updated language support.
Localized text is now available for the following languages: French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Serbian, Russian, Ukrainian, and Polish.
That's everything we have to share for today!

Most of these changes and updates were made in direct response to you, our wonderful playtesters, sharing your bug reports and suggestions, so please continue to share your experiences here on Steam, or on Bluesky, Twitter, TikTok, Instagram, and our official Discord!

releases.displayName: Playtest update with a brand new room 👀✨

items.text: Hello, renovators!

Thank you so much to those of you who have taken the time to try the Hozy playtest so far, we’ve loved seeing your feedback, screenshots, and videos as you discover the world of Hozy and what makes it so special.
We’re incredibly excited to be able to share with you today that the Hozy playtest has now been updated!
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/79XfLQn.gif"]

You’ll now be able to renovate an additional brand new room as part of the playtest; once belonging to a slightly eccentric scientist, it’s a tiny downtown apartment that is going to need a lot of love and care before you can start unpacking the new occupant’s belongings.
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/zbVRAWQ.gif"]

With limited space, you’ll want to get creative and utilize the shelves and balcony as much as possible to make sure the space really feels like home. Your incoming occupant has some bulky items in her possession, so there’s no denying it will be a challenge to make sure the tiny apartment fits everything she needs.
We’re looking forward to seeing how you adapt the space to make it just right for the new owner!
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/wrNRSMz.gif"]
To experience the new room, simply update or download the Hozy Playtest in your Steam library - and please do leave feedback if there’s anything you’d like to contribute!

If you’d like to continue to stay updated on Hozy’s development, make sure to wishlist us here on Steam, follow us on Bluesky, Twitter, TikTok, and Instagram, and join our Discord to share your experiences in the playtest so far!
We look forward to having more to share with you soon!

releases.displayName: Playtest Update and macOS version are now live!

items.text: UPD. We found an issue which could prevent some of you from installing MacOS version - it's fixed now. You may need to relaunch Steam to proceed to download.
Hello everyone!

We hope you're having a lovely time cleaning and renovating rooms in Hozy! Seeing your amazing screenshots in Discord and on social media fills us with joy. Your creativity gives us so much energy and inspiration to keep making Hozy even cozier and better.
We’ve been actively reading your feedback, watching your streams and YouTube videos, and already making changes based on the things you’ve pointed out. Thank you so much for that!
And speaking of updates, today we're happy to share what’s new in this small patch for the current playtest:

Need to temporarily set aside a lamp or table you’re not ready to place? Simply throw it outside the room (don’t worry, it won’t get damaged or disappear). It will be stored in a special Lost & Found box, ready for you to retrieve and use later when inspiration strikes!

[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc1ViRFwuVV0vBUrsJjVtBM8TxjPSO3vfHybNh0y293U9-CaYiTD-KkH5kMloRo_SD91EgRpAN3uQvs_X7n20RQVeqkSByY1DJlq67RvqZS_4s8Iow2p_ulOSTY4s7xA3QI_XE66w?key=x-luw7gWhbCGTx9hx3nZbQ"]
We want Hozy to be available to as many people as possible, and we’re happy to announce that the game is now playable on macOS! Join the playtest today and let us know what you think.
Please note that to run the game on your Mac, you need to have at least macOS 13.0 installed. This is our experimental build, so the game might have some performance issues.
We’ve added new tooltips to make it easier to learn how to use tools and interact with objects. We aim to help you jump into Hozy without friction and enjoy the cozy flow from the start.
Hozy is now available in even more languages so renovators around the world can enjoy the game with ease:
French, Russian, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Serbian, Ukrainian, Polish, Simplified Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.
Added many new sound effects for object interactions
Fixed various small bugs
General performance improvements
That’s it for today!
Let us know what you think, and keep sharing your rooms, clips, and feedback with us in our Discord.
